description: This file defines API route handlers for product-related operations in an e-commerce backend system using Express. It sets up RESTful endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products, with appropriate middleware for authentication, authorization, and validation. Swagger annotations are included for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all products.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product, requiring admin role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID, requiring admin role.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, requiring admin role.
